verdict.rationale: EBANX documents a single unified API covering all payment methods and countries (ebanx-docs-18). It also documents expanding payment methods with small payload tweaks (ebanx-docs-8), local methods like Pix (ebanx-docs-3), and alternative payment method acceptance (ebanx-docs-34), so local methods from one integration are evidenced. None of the evidence names the specific wallets or BNPL options in the story. missing for 10: explicit Apple Pay and Google Pay support, documented bank-redirect flows, BNPL support, independent or hands-on corroboration.
